packageRules.description: Pin com.palantir.consistent-versions to 2.32.0; newer versions require Java 17 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Pin org.carrot2:carrot2-core to 4.5.1; 4.8.6 requires Java 21 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Keep org.apache.hadoop on 3.4.x; 3.5.0 requires Java 17 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Pin dev.langchain4j to 0.35.0; 0.36.2 requires Java 17 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Keep Error Prone on 2.31.0; the build hard-pins it to 2.31.0 for JDK11 compatibility on branch_9x
Pin no.nav.security:mock-oauth2-server to 0.5.10; every 1.0.0+ release requires Java 17 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Pin com.carrotsearch:hppc to 0.10.0; 0.11.0+ is compiled for Java 21 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Keep com.diffplug.spotless on the 7.x line on branch_9x; 8.0.0 bumps the required Java to 17.

Keep the Jetty 10.x line on branch_9x; Jetty 11 moves the Servlet API from javax.servlet to jakarta.servlet (branch_9x is still on javax.servlet throughout), and Jetty 12 additionally requires Java 17 but branch_9x builds with Java 11
Pin org.semver4j:semver4j to 5.x; 6.0.0 is compiled to Java 17 but branch_9x builds with Java 11

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month
